name: Anaheim Community Services Volunteers (ages 13 and up)
org: City of Anaheim Community Services Department
what_you_do: Volunteer with the city during the year. Clear trails and pull weeds at Oak Canyon Nature Center. Help coach youth sports camps at East Anaheim Gym. Help kids with homework and games after school, or spend time with seniors.
who_can_apply: Anyone at least 13 years old. No school or city rule is stated for these year-round roles.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. These roles run all year. The separate Summer VolunTEEN program has its own spring deadline.
how_to_apply: Fill out an application and book a free fingerprint check with the Volunteer Coordinator. Call 714-765-4994 or email VolunteerOffice@anaheim.net. Some roles also need a TB test from the last 2 years.
notes: Fingerprinting is free, but you pay for your own TB test. The page does not post open shifts, so ask the coordinator which roles need help now. Court ordered hours go to the Graffiti Removal Program instead (714-765-5158).
